requirements.description: Archive exact SLVSCM8D datasheet bytes. RHL0020A land geometry separately reviewed against 4219071/A; confirm every pad-21 contact and stencil/thermal implementation in consumer.
Review source range, mode-dependent feedback/current-limit tolerances, actual switching frequency, effective MLCC capacitance, inductor L under current, RMS, saturation and temperature.
Review minimum copper/plating, every pad neckdown and via, pack, switch, connector and harness peak/RMS capacity. A calculated resistance is not ampacity.
Review filled routed copper against TI EVM boost output hot-loop, quiet feedback/compensation, local decoupling, all parallel power contacts and ground/thermal paths.

SLVUAF2 section 2.1 and Figure 7 separate VIN pin9 control supply from the inductor power input through JP1. Preserve the dedicated input_sense/vin_entry/vin branch and local 100 nF ceramic VIN bypass (SLVSCM8D pin table p3, section 9.2.2.6 p17). input_sense alone has an authored 0.2 mm control_supply width allowance; input_main remains 2 mm. Verify startup and supply ripple with the actual return and bulk bank; quiescent current is not a transient-current bound. No main-power width exception or production qualification is implied.

The authored 1 mm output tail and OUTPUT port end at local (1.5,6.7) mm, 0.8 mm beyond the unchanged local-support boundary at y=5.9 mm. Verify exact host access at its actual width and clearance, including native ground refill. The intended 1 mm host track with 0.15 mm clearance requires 0.65 mm center offset. This tail extension changes no chip or capacitor-bank connection, gives no foreign-copper or protected-region permission, and does not qualify current or EMI performance.
Review exact configuration and validated models for stability, source/load transients, startup, current limit, shutdown pass-through and independent load disconnection.
Measure minimum source voltage, full duty envelope, switch/inductor currents, output excursions, startup/shutdown, fault behavior, EMI and temperatures with actual pack and enclosure.

notes: Authored four-layer physical adaptation for TPS61088RHLR, SRP1265A-2R2M, selected passive footprints. Electrical parts and values remain consumer-owned. Six external PGND vias replace unsupported four-layer filled-capped via-in-pad process; thermal and current qualification is open. This circuit macro is not manufacturer-extracted CAD. The lower-right protected-region boundary is stepped inward outside the output-bulk courtyard; external GND return copper remains owned and clearance-checked. Adjacent same-net pads and vias require assembly and solder-mask review.
